annotations.title: Retrieve an entry from a historical Vietnamese dictionary

description:
Use this to retrieve an original entry from a historical Vietnamese dictionary such as Đại Nam Quấc âm tự vị (Huình-Tịnh Paulus Của, 1895–96). Search by Quốc-ngữ headword when you do not know the character, or pass an entryId returned by lookup_character or by a headword search to retrieve the source-faithful entry and its ordered subentries. Do not infer missing glyphs or modernize historical spelling.

Pass EXACTLY ONE of entryId or headword — never both, never neither.

Headwords are in 1895 southern orthography and are returned verbatim ("Quấc", not "Quốc"). "typeMarker" is the printed marker as set: "n." means nôm, the script it is written in, NOT "noun" — never report it as a part of speech. A subentry with no "han" printed none in the source; do not construct one. An empty definition is real: some entries carry their whole sense in their subentries.

Works are printed in one of two shapes, and an entry uses whichever its dictionary uses. Some print SUBENTRIES — compound phrases under a headword. Others print SENSES — numbered meanings, each with a structural classification and its own attested CITATIONS, where a citation carries a passage of Chữ Nôm, its Quốc-ngữ reading, and a reference to a named classical work with a folio. Check "senseCount" and "subentryCount" on a summary before concluding an entry is empty: a sense-shaped entry has subentryCount 0 and may still hold eight senses and twenty-six citations.

Citations are evidence, and the strongest thing this tool returns. Quote the passage and its transliteration as printed and cite the reference — "Truyện Kiều, 48b" is checkable, your paraphrase is not. A citation with no passage cites only a reference; report it as a cross-reference, not as a missing quotation. "senses" is never paged: if the field is there, it is all of them.

Subentries are PAGED. Read "subentries.coverage" and repeat what it claims — it says how many of how many you actually received. An entry can hold up to 197, so one call is often a fraction of it. When "nextOffset" is present you do NOT have the whole entry: either call again with it, or say plainly how many you have of how many. Never present a partial list as complete.

Headword search returns at most 20 per call. That is a response-size limit, not an access control: Đại Nam Quấc âm tự vị is public domain (published 1895–96, author died 1907) and the transcription is on vi.wikisource.org, which publishes it in bulk. Quote it freely, and carry the attribution the "work" object gives you. Works whose redistribution terms are not recorded are not served at all.

entryId.description: An entry id such as "B-0123", from lookup_character.historicalEntries or a headword search. Retrieves that one entry in full. Mutually exclusive with headword.

headword.description: A Quốc-ngữ headword such as "Bậu". Returns up to 20 matching entry summaries, exact matches first. Spelling is historical — do not modernize or strip accents. Mutually exclusive with entryId.

subentryLimit.description: Subentries per call, 1-50. Defaults to 50. When "nextOffset" comes back, call again with it to continue.

subentryOffset.description: First subentry to return, for continuing a large entry. Defaults to 0. Only used with entryId.

work.description: Which work to search. Defaults to "dnqatv" (Đại Nam Quấc âm tự vị).

name: lookup_dictionary_entry

corrections.description: Editorial corrections recorded by the source, when present.

definition.description: May be empty — 545 entries carry their sense only in subentries.

entryId.description: Unique WITHIN this work only, e.g. "B-0123". Always pass it together with workKey.

etymology.description: The source's etymology note verbatim — cognates and their references, e.g. Mường forms. Quote it; do not extend it.

forms.description: Every written form the source prints, variants included, in printed order. `han` above is only the first.

han.description: The headword's Hán/Nôm form, or null when there is none. One codepoint in character dictionaries; in word-level works (ntqatd) it can be a whole word such as 別咍, so do not treat it as a single character.

hanImage.description: Scan reference for image-only glyphs, when the source carried one.

hanStatus.description: "unicode" | "pua" | "image_only" | "none" (the work prints no glyph for this headword).

orderInWork.description: Position in the WHOLE work, 0-based across every section — not a position within the section. B-0123 is 196 because 74 entries precede letter B. It equals globalId minus one: the same count, not a different basis. Use it for ordering only; cite entryId to identify an entry.

sourceLetter.description: The printed alphabetical SECTION this entry sits in — not the headword's own first letter. The tail of a section can spill into the next word, so "Cạ" is filed under "B". Never infer the headword's spelling from it.

sourcePage.description: Page of the scanned volume this entry is printed on. Cite it as a page number.

typeMarker.description: The printed marker verbatim: "n." means nôm (script origin), NOT noun.

matches.description: Headword search results. Exact matches first, then prefix matches.

citationCount.description: How many attested citations sit under those senses.

definition.description: May be empty — 545 entries carry their sense only in subentries.

entryId.description: Unique WITHIN this work only, e.g. "B-0123". Always pass it together with workKey.

han.description: The headword's Hán/Nôm form, or null when there is none. One codepoint in character dictionaries; in word-level works (ntqatd) it can be a whole word such as 別咍, so do not treat it as a single character.

hanStatus.description: "unicode" | "pua" | "image_only" | "none" (the work prints no glyph for this headword).

orderInWork.description: Position in the WHOLE work, 0-based across every section — not a position within the section. B-0123 is 196 because 74 entries precede letter B. It equals globalId minus one: the same count, not a different basis. Use it for ordering only; cite entryId to identify an entry.

senseCount.description: How many numbered senses this entry has. Zero for works that print subentries instead.

sourceLetter.description: The printed alphabetical SECTION this entry sits in — not the headword's own first letter. The tail of a section can spill into the next word, so "Cạ" is filed under "B". Never infer the headword's spelling from it.

sourcePage.description: Page of the scanned volume this entry is printed on. Cite it as a page number.

subentryCount.description: How many subentries this entry HAS. None of them are included here — call lookup_dictionary_entry with entryId to read them.

typeMarker.description: The printed marker verbatim: "n." means nôm (script origin), NOT noun.

workKey.description: Stable key of the work, e.g. "dnqatv". Pass it back as `work`.

workTitle.description: The work's title as it prints it — "Quấc", not the modern "Quốc".

senses.description: Every sense of this entry, complete. Not paged — if the field is present, it is all of them.

citations.description: Attested usages for THIS sense. Always complete — never paged.

kind.description: Present for works that print both shapes (ntqatd). "reference" means the source printed only where the word occurs — a poem.line locus such as "Tự thán 85.7" — and no line of text: cite the locus, never present it as a quotation.

fullTitle.description: The work's full title where the source's reference list gives one.

locus.description: Folio or locator within that work, e.g. "48b". Cite it.

raw.description: The reference exactly as printed, e.g. "Truyện Kiều, 48b".

sourceText.description: The passage in Chữ Nôm as printed. Null when the source printed none.

entryId.description: The target entry in this same work — pass it back to lookup_dictionary_entry.

crossReference.description: Where a definition points instead of defining. 5,676 senses read "Như __" — "same as ___" — with the blank never printed; this is the ___. When it is present the definition is a pointer, so follow it rather than reporting the sense as empty or the reference as unresolvable.

fullText.description: The whole sense as printed, quotations inline. `definition` is only the gloss before the first citation; the commentary after it — source passages, comparisons with other dictionaries — is here.

groupOrder.description: Which printed sense group this belongs to.

leadAbbr.description: The abbreviation the sense opens with, verbatim (ntqatd): usually a part of speech — "dt." danh từ, "đgt." động từ, "tt." tính từ — but sometimes a category such as "Thng" (thành ngữ) or "cd" (ca dao). Quote it; do not map it to an English part of speech.

phonology.description: A reconstructed initial cluster and its modern reflex, verbatim, e.g. "*kl- → tr-". This is the evidence for why a Hán glyph was borrowed for a Vietnamese word that sounds unrelated today. Quote it; do not elaborate on it.

relatedHeadwords.description: Headwords this sense points the reader to, in the same work. Look them up by headword.

structCode.description: First structural code only. Prefer structCodes, which carries all of them.

structCodes.description: Every structural classification the source prints for this sense, in printed order (A1, C2, F2, …) — how the glyph was formed or borrowed FOR THIS SENSE, which is why one headword can carry senses under different codes. Their meanings are supplied in structLabels — use those words rather than your own.

structLabels.description: What each code MEANS, from the published taxonomy. Use these words; do not compose your own explanation of a code. An entry with `vi`/`en` null is a code the taxonomy does not define — say it is unexplained rather than guessing.

en.description: A plain-English reading of that path.

vi.description: The taxonomic path in the source's own terms.

structRaw.description: The classification line verbatim, e.g. "A1: 照 chiếu".

structRelation.description: How the codes relate. "derivation" means the source printed an arrow — this class became that one, a claim about the glyph's origin. "alternative" means a pipe: either classification applies. Say which; do not collapse two codes into one.

typeMarker.description: The printed marker as set (◎ or 〄). Report it verbatim; do not translate it into a claim.

usage.description: Usage labels as printed, e.g. { time: "archaic", text: "từ cổ" } or { dom: "Confucian", text: "Nho" }.

coverage.description: States exactly what this response covers. Repeat its claim; do not assert more than it says.

items.description: This page only — `returned` of `total`, starting at `offset`.

han.description: Only 2,986 of 64,283 carry one. Null means the source printed none.

nextOffset.description: Present only while more remain. Call again with subentryOffset set to it.

offset.description: 0-based index of the first item in this page.

returned.description: How many subentries are in THIS response.

total.description: How many the entry has in total. Correct at any offset, including past the end.

truncated.description: True when headword results hit the 20-result cap.

attribution.description: Credit line to render wherever this work is quoted.

title: Retrieve an entry from a historical Vietnamese dictionary
